subject: MPA: Security acceptance proofs, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and retention logistics
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestline.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA: Security acceptance proofs, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and retention logistics

Hi Lena / team,

Thanks for the productive MAP sync this morning. Per our conversation I wanted to capture the immediate asks and next steps related to the security/compliance gates so we can keep the evaluation moving toward your close timeline. High level: SOC 2 evidence handoff, the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet you mentioned, and a DPA redline that reflects the 24-month retention window you requested.

Quick summary of asks (so we have a single thread for evidence tracking):
- Crestline: share completed SIG/CAIQ template with answers you need from us (we saw the version during the call).
- Redwood: provide SOC 2 artifact bundle + evidence owners for each control (we can deliver a compressed package and a short index).
- Legal/DPA: deliver a DPA redline for your review that includes the 24-month retention clause and data residency appendix for US-only processing.

Action owners / timing:
- Diego: coordinate SOC 2 artifact delivery and send initial zip by EOD 7/04.
- Marissa: prepare a short evidence index (control -> artifact filename) and flag anything that is redacted or needs POA&M. Target: 7/05 EOD.
- Kimberly: lead DPA redline and confirm whether Crestline needs KMS/HSM language or escrow specifics. Target: first pass 7/05 morning.

Attachments I'll include in the next email: SOC 2 summary (stub) and the draft DPA (v2). Lena — if you can upload the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet to the HubSpot record or attach it here that helps.

Couple of clarifying Qs for the MAP so we don't spin:
1) Is the retention window strict 24 months from creation, or do you prefer 24 months from last access? (affects archival policy)
2) For SOC 2 sampling, do you require full control artifacts or is an index + representative samples sufficient for the evaluation stage?

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want a quick handoff with our compliance team.

Thanks,
Diego Fernández
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0187

---
Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.txt (summary), redwood-dpa-draft-v2.pdf (DPA first pass)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestline.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MPA: Security acceptance proofs, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and retention logistics

Diego — thanks for the note and the clear owners. Attached is the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet we referenced during the call (see 'crestline-sig-answers.xlsx' attached). A couple of answers / constraints from our side:

- Retention: Crestline's legal prefers 24 months from last transaction (last access is acceptable) — but we can confirm final language with procurement.
- SOC 2 sampling: during evaluation we typically accept an index + representative evidence for 10-15 controls; production acceptance requires full evidence.
- KMS/HSM: we require proof of encryption key management and need to know if key material is customer-managed or Redwood-managed.

Next steps for us: our procurement counsel will review your DPA redline. If Kimberly can flag KMS options in the DPA we can circulate to legal for a faster review.

Thanks — attaching the spreadsheet now.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Infrastructure & Security Programs
Crestline Financial

---
Attachment: crestline-sig-answers.xlsx

From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestline.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Jul 2027 20:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: Security acceptance proofs, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and retention logistics

Thanks Lena — that helps a lot. Marissa / Kimberly, copying the specifics so we can translate into deliverables:

- Retention: Crestline prefers 24 months from last access (we'll propose that language in the DPA).
- SOC 2: Crestline will accept index + representative samples for first evaluation. We should pick 12 controls covering CC6, CC7, and CC8 areas (access, encryption, change mgmt).
- KMS: Kimberly, please advise whether we can offer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for Crestline, or if we need a carveout and explicit HSM/KMS language.

Marissa — can you draft the evidence index (control -> filename) and include sample file references (e.g., user-access-logs-202706.zip, encryption-keys-arch.pdf) and drop it here? Aim for EOD tomorrow so Lena's team can start sampling.

I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and DPA redline now (see attachments). Note the DPA v2 includes a proposed retention clause and an appendix that calls out US-only processing. We still need to add KMS options.

Thanks — Diego

---
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.txt, redwood-dpa-draft-v2.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crestline.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: Security acceptance proofs, SIG/CAIQ clarifications, and retention logistics

Thanks — I reviewed the SIG spreadsheet and DPA draft. Quick plan and asks from compliance: 

1) KMS options: we support both Redwood-managed keys and a customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS Bring-Your-Own-Key. I'll add a short appendix to the DPA describing the operational differences and recommended language for escrow/rotation.

2) SOC 2 evidence package: Marissa, let's assemble the index with three sample bundles: access-controls-sample.zip, change-management-sample.pdf, encryption-configs-sample.zip. We'll flag anything with PII and provide redacted copies where necessary. Plan: index + 12 representative artifacts delivered by 7/05 17:00 PT.

3) Retention language: propose "24 months from last access" with a clear archival path and deletion SLA of 60 days following the end of retention window; I'll include text in the DPA redline. If Crestline legal pushes on earlier deletion, we'll provide options.

4) Evidence delivery: I'll prepare a short manifest.csv that maps control IDs to artifact filenames and owner contact (example: CC7-3 -> encryption-configs-sample.zip -> compliance@redwood.ai).

I'll attach the DPA redline in DocuSign-ready form and the manifest stub (filenames above) to the HubSpot record. Lena — if that timeline works, we'll proceed and ping legal once the DPA has the KMS appendix.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
